goal: Editable, coloured CAD of the espresso set registered to the photo's own camera, so the overlay can be scored per colour region
geometry_plan: Decompose: saucer (revolved), cup body (revolved, red), cup glaze (thin white revolved lining and rim), espresso (revolved fill), handle (ring fused to the body), spoon (bowl + handle, two parts)
Measure the main bodies: fit a perspective IMAGE_FRAME to the cup rim, saucer rim and cup foot (three circles), then solve the cup's side profile from silhouette edges through that frame
Use typical sizes for the small parts: a 105 mm teaspoon lying in the saucer with its handle on the rim, anchored on its bowl and handle-end pixels
Handle: ring centre solved so it projects onto the handle in the photo
